description.narrative: Providing health services to PRS will remain one of the Agency’s core humanitarian activities in 2023 given the impacts of the economic crisis on the health system and the increasing prices of medications and hospitalisation services. In 2023, free-of-charge primary health care services will be provided to PRS through the 27 UNRWA primary health-care centres, of which 13 are located inside Palestine refugee camps and 14 are located in Palestinian gatherings. Services in HCs will continue to be enhanced through the use of the Agency’s electronic patient record system (e-Health), which allows for easy tracking of patients’ medical history. UNRWA will also continue to cover 90 per cent of secondary health care and 60 per cent of tertiary health care for PRS and support tertiary health services for PRL and PRS with chronic diseases. .
